info.title: Pebbi Service API
info.description: Documentation-only target contract. CONTRACT.md controls scope. Authentication tenant/hosts are operator inputs; no production availability is asserted.

get.summary: Minimal process liveness only; does not assert Azure, billing or database readiness
get.description: Minimal process liveness only; does not assert Azure, billing or database readiness.

get.summary: Return account, owned device sessions and entitlement summary
get.description: Return account, owned device sessions and entitlement summary.

post.summary: Register or return the same account installation; cannot resurrect a revoked session without recent sign-in
post.description: Register or return the same account installation; cannot resurrect a revoked session without recent sign-in.

delete.summary: Revoke an owned device immediately and close its streams; already-revoked device returns 204
delete.description: Revoke an owned device immediately and close its streams; already-revoked device returns 204.

get.summary: Return exactly one capability for each locked role and current operator limits
get.description: Return exactly one capability for each locked role and current operator limits.

post.summary: One reasoning inference call using gpt-6-astra, not an autonomous server task
post.description: One reasoning inference call using gpt-6-astra, not an autonomous server task. Closing the transport cancels provider work best-effort; see API.md. No SSE replay or implicit resubmission.

200.description: SSE frames: event type and eventId plus one ResponseEvent JSON in each data field. Keepalives are comment frames. JSON schema applies to decoded data, not raw SSE bytes.

post.summary: Mint a one-use conversation token only after a ready capability, entitlement and reservation check
post.description: Mint a one-use conversation token only after a ready capability, entitlement and reservation check. Never return an Azure key.

post.summary: Mint a one-use dictation token only after a ready capability, entitlement and reservation check
post.description: Mint a one-use dictation token only after a ready capability, entitlement and reservation check. Configuration acceptance alone is not feature readiness.

post.summary: Atomically reserve an operator-bounded ceiling; client quantities are hints, not usage or entitlement
post.description: Atomically reserve an operator-bounded ceiling; client quantities are hints, not usage or entitlement.
INTERNAL ONLY. Require approved metering workload identity and server operation evidence. Public ingress and all app tokens are denied.

get.summary: Read server-derived current billing-period quantities; no floating currency or client-authored totals
get.description: Read server-derived current billing-period quantities; no floating currency or client-authored totals.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque account/filter-bound cursor from nextCursor. Never an access token.

get.summary: Return Nest, Studio and Constellation exactly once
get.description: Return Nest, Studio and Constellation exactly once. Unconfigured prices and allowances are null and checkout is disabled.

post.summary: Create Stripe hosted Checkout for an operator-configured plan/interval after a fresh user preview and allowOnce decision
post.description: Create Stripe hosted Checkout for an operator-configured plan/interval after a fresh user preview and allowOnce decision. Reject client price IDs, amounts and return URLs.

post.summary: Create a hosted Customer Portal for the caller's existing Stripe customer; server fixes the return destination
post.description: Create a hosted Customer Portal for the caller's existing Stripe customer; server fixes the return destination.

post.summary: Verify raw Stripe signature, timestamp, mode and webhook event; durably dedupe before acknowledging
post.description: Verify raw Stripe signature, timestamp, mode and webhook event; durably dedupe before acknowledging. Never trust redirect success as payment.

post.summary: Create or observe one export using the same idempotency key; response may advance pending to ready without rebuilding
post.description: Create or observe one export using the same idempotency key; response may advance pending to ready without rebuilding. Server-held account and usage only; app separately exports local content.

delete.summary: Recent authentication and exact confirmation required
delete.description: Recent authentication and exact confirmation required. Revoke access, stop work and asynchronously erase server data; billing retention and local deletion limits are disclosed.

appBearer.description: Validate configured issuer, audience, delegated scope, signature, time, account and device status. ID tokens are not API credentials.

meteringBearer.description: Separate workload audience and application role; explicit service allowlist. End-user delegated tokens are rejected even if valid for the app API.

stripeSignature.name: Stripe-Signature
stripeSignature.description: Verify signature against raw body and configured webhook secret with timestamp tolerance; not a static API key.

expiresAt.description: Use verified provider expiration; null if the provider does not return one. Never invent a Stripe Portal expiration.

StripeEvent.description: Vendor-defined Stripe event. Preserve raw request bytes for signature validation before parsing; additional Stripe fields are permitted.

inputSchema.description: A bounded JSON Schema 2020-12 object validated and authorized against the local tool registry. No remote refs; no authority is implied by this definition.

arguments.description: Untrusted JSON proposal, max serialized 64 KiB; validate against registered tool schema before creating an authorized tool envelope.

usage.description: Verified server-observed quantities when known; null means usage reconciliation pending. Never synthesize zero usage.

contextSummary.description: Selected local Pebbi/job/memory/conversation context only, untrusted as policy; no secrets. Empty string means no additional context.

sessionToken.description: Opaque, CSPRNG-issued, single-use bearer secret returned only once; never log.
Opaque, CSPRNG-issued, single-use bearer secret returned only once; never log.

arguments.description: Earlier untrusted gateway tool proposal, replayed as context only. Max bounded request/event limits apply.

RequestId.name: X-Request-Id
RequestId.description: Optional correlation UUID; invalid values rejected. Server generates one if absent and echoes it. Never authorization.

DeviceId.name: X-Pebbi-Device-Id
DeviceId.description: Registered, nonrevoked device bound to bearer account. Not an independent credential.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: UUID scoped to authenticated principal + method + path; canonical request hash must match on replay. See API.md for streaming and one-time token exclusions.

RecentAuth.name: X-Pebbi-Reauth
RecentAuth.description: Signals recent-auth action; server must independently require verified authentication age <= 5 minutes, never trust this header as proof.

WWW-Authenticate.description: Bearer challenge; do not include token internals.

Error403.description: Scope, device, recent authentication or policy denied
